summary: Object.groupBy calls a grouping callback for each iterable item and collects original items into arrays under the returned property keys.
documentation: Object.groupBy calls a grouping callback for each iterable item and collects original items into arrays under the returned property keys. Group members preserve input order. The returned object has a null prototype, avoiding inherited object-property names.
inputs: A list of records with string team and integer id.
returns: An object mapping team names to arrays of complete records.
caution: The groups contain the original object references, not deep copies. A null-prototype result does not have an inherited hasOwnProperty method; use Object.hasOwn when checking keys.
scenarios: Group locally loaded jobs by assigned team.
Organize imported tasks into status sections without sorting each group.
Build a report preview containing all records for each category.
title: Group records without losing order
problem: Group the input records by team. Keep every complete record and preserve order within each team, including duplicates. Return an empty object for no records.
goal: Use Object.groupBy() or an equivalent approach demonstrating the same premise.
